rootCauseOneLine: Six independent first-paint gaps: Tasks useTasksQuery starts every mount at data:undefined and keeps the previous view's data across a view switch (ListView renders "No tasks yet" from it); PluginPanelView shows "not available" whenever navPanels.find is null with no "plugins booted" flag; header/sidebar plugin chrome derives only from live registrations; the localStorage catalog placeholder is written/read only for claude-code so other providers get models:[] -> isLoadingModels; useThreadDefaultExecutionOptions and useSidebarNavigation have no placeholderData.

prReviews.topFinding: Fixes item 1b for real (route-scope gating in ListView, verified live: no more 'No tasks yet' on Active->All) and hydrates the Tasks sidebar from a zod-validated localStorage snapshot; 337 plugin tests pass and it applies cleanly on main. But the list body still shows skeleton rows on every populated visit (useListTasks is not snapshotted, 29 pulse nodes measured), and the toolbar 'N tasks' count is not gated by routeScopeChanged so All shows Active's '0 tasks' for one frame.

Right layer and right idea for items 2-6, but CONFLICTING with main: system-queries.ts / claude-model-catalog-cache.ts were rewritten by #1741 (resolveExecutionOptionsPlaceholder, catalog cache v2 with providers), so the placeholder/provider-list cache must be re-derived, not merged. Also persists the whole sidebar-bootstrap (every unarchived thread) into localStorage on every fetch of a frequently-invalidated query (main-thread stringify + 5MB quota risk), and consumers NewThreadComposer project resolution and ProjectSettingsView are not gated on isPlaceholderData so a stale replay binds a new project's compose route to Personal / shows 'No sources configured' for a beat.

proposedFix: Land item 2 first as a tiny PR: a 'plugin frontends settled' flag set in bootPluginFrontends()'s finally (plus a floor timeout) and PluginPanelView renders an empty PageShell until then. Item 1b: gate the ListView body (and toolbar count) on a route-scope-changed flag until that scope's own fetch settles (the file already tracks scopeChanged for scroll restoration). Items 4/5: generalize the existing claude-model-catalog-cache to (environmentId, hostId, providerId) written for any provider whose probe succeeded, and add per-thread placeholderData to useThreadDefaultExecutionOptions with isPlaceholderData gating on submission/permission; build on #1741's resolveExecutionOptionsPlaceholder. Items 3/6: remember host chrome (pluginId/id/path/title/icon) and a bounded projection of the sidebar bootstrap (not the full response on every fetch; or use an async persistQueryClient), and make sidebar-data consumers that make decisions (NewThreadComposer project resolution, ProjectSettingsView) ignore placeholder data. Item 1a/1c: plugin-local snapshot as in #1677, or an SDK-level cached-query primitive.
caveats: Timings are from my fast local instance (natural windows 30-800 ms) rather than the reporter's 450 ms-6.9 s; screenshot windows were widened with a Vite dev-server delay middleware (patch saved, reverted from the worktree). Split-pane plugin title (part of item 3) was not exercised separately (same navPanels source). PR #1678 could not be run in my worktree because it conflicts with main; findings on it are from diff reading plus consumer-code inspection on main. Playwright page.route delays do not work inside the dev-browser sandbox (route.continue/fetch never complete), hence the server-side delay. One incidental unexplained observation: a thread-page reload once showed the 'not available' copy in main for ~270 ms before the thread view painted.
